heroTitle: Remove Watermarks from PDF Files Safely
heroDescription: Redact or remove intrusive watermarks from your PDF documents. Fully private, browser-based watermark removal tool.

sections.subTitle: Clean Your PDFs
sections.subContent: Remove unwanted stamps, backgrounds, and watermarks.

sections.subTitle: Local Redaction
sections.subContent: Erase sensitive watermarks without uploading files to our servers.

sections.subTitle: Flawless Quality
sections.subContent: We remove the watermark object without degrading your document quality.

faqs.q: Does it remove text watermarks or image watermarks?
faqs.a: Our tool allows you to draw redaction boxes over both text and image watermarks, effectively erasing them permanently.

faqs.q: Can anyone recover the watermark after removal?
faqs.a: No. The redacted areas are permanently flattened and rasterized, so the hidden data is completely destroyed and unrecoverable.

faqs.q: Do I need to pay to remove watermarks?
faqs.a: Our tool is 100% free with no hidden fees, subscriptions, or intrusive premium pop-ups.
